title: auricula-ursi spectabilis
intro: Auricula-ursi spectabilis, commonly known as bearberry, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the heath family (Ericaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include being a natural diuretic and having antibacterial properties that help in treating urinary tract infections. The therapeutic actions of bearberry include treating conditions such as kidney stones, cystitis, and bladder infections, due to its ability to increase urine production and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of bearberry include arbutin, which is responsible for its diuretic and antibacterial properties, as well as other compounds like phenolic acids and flavonoids that contribute to its medicinal effects.
